findings.claim: BX 10-K 稱資產管理業競爭激烈，傳統資管機構已自建私募股權與私人財富平台；私人財富與保險通路有競爭者以較低費用或較高分銷費搶募資，且費用與附帶權益存在下降風險。
findings.excerpt: certain traditional asset managers have developed their own private equity and private wealth platforms and are marketing other asset allocation strategies as alternatives to hedge fund investments.

findings.claim: BX 10-K 稱私人財富與保險通路募資競爭，部分對手願收較低費用或付較高分銷費。
findings.excerpt: competition for fundraising in the private wealth and insurance channels is also driven by the willingness of certain of our competitors to charge lower fees or pay higher or different types of distributors fees.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋結果摘要（altswire、wealthmanagement.com）提及BX私人財富募資2025年$43B（+53%）、CFO引述分析稱BX約占主要另類資管私人財富營收50%，為公司引述估計；未讀到頁面故僅列clues。Apollo、Ares亦擴張私人財富產品。

clues.claim: BX 2025 私人財富募資年增53%至$43B，私人財富AUM $300B；CFO引述分析稱BX約占主要另類資管私人財富營收50%（公司引述估計）。
clues.source: AltsWire 'Private wealth push propels Blackstone to record 2025 performance'
